Assistant A gives a well-structured outline with a title, introduction, subheadings (design, performance, camera, UI, price), and conclusion, which is what the user asked for. Its word count is roughly 150, which is under the 200-word limit.

Assistant B does not provide an outline. It is a repetitive, contradictory list of claims (e.g., the first model has both a better and worse camera), with no structure or subheadings, and it likely exceeds 200 words.

Assistant A is clearly better.
